Install writes the agent skill for each harness found on this machine (its
CLI on PATH, or its config dir): Claude Code gets
<config dir>/skills/agent/SKILL.md ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude)
and gomuxai's hook in its user settings (as agent hooks install; the
settings file is copied to backups/ in the data dir first), and agy gets
~/.gemini/config/skills/agent/SKILL.md. --harness installs for that one,
found or not. Files that already say the same are left as they are.

Usage:
  agent skill install [flags]

Examples:
  agent skill install
  agent skill install --harness agy

Flags:
      --harness string   Harness to install for: claude or agy (default: every one found)
  -h, --help             help for install

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
